coverage_notes: House trades: the dataset's House filings begin 2014-01-02; earlier House years are marked none (a few late-filed earlier trades still appear).
Senate trades: filings begin 2012-07-25 (STOCK Act PTRs began July 2012).
Money coverage per year comes from the money source plug-ins; it is none where no plug-in declares it.
Committee assignments (sits_with) are the current Congress only.

events_member_not_in_spine.reason: memberId not found among people with a term since 2000

filings: pages 1-4 rows R1-R34: Read B (the filed pages alone) lists more transactions than the OCR text holds rows on page 6 (90 listed, 17 OCR table rows), page 7 (74 listed, 32 OCR table rows)
failed_extraction_filings.reason: the dataset could not extract the filing with confidence; it contributes no trades

non_member_trade_rows.reason: filer never served in Congress (staff, candidates); the dataset gives them no events

superseded_event_versions.reason: older versions of amended events; the current version is kept and flagged amended

trade_rows_folded_into_events.reason: repeat printings of the same economic trade (duplicate filings, amendments) folded by the dataset into one event

unresolved_identity_trade_rows.reason: filer could not be matched to a member

publication_budget.case_rule: A Case is a member-org pair with at least 2 distinct filed edge types, at least one of family holding and at least one of family money or people, whose year ranges overlap. Ranked by number of types, then money amount, then trade count.
publication_budget.rule: Full Edge objects appear only in member files: every non-money edge, every Case edge and the 10 largest money edges per member. Other money ties are ledger rows (complete for current members, largest 100 for former members); ledger_totals always cover all of them. Org files list every non-money tie and money ties for their 200 largest members; ledger_totals cover the rest.
